name: Guatemala. ~Joseiki Kakuchou Yuugi~
source:
Company run by main heroine's parents accumulates huge debt and goes bankrupt. There is a benefactor who agrees to restructure the debt if girl is given to him. She does not know yet what devilish training awaits her.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-december-2006-kimi-no-koe.html]vndbreview[/url]]
